content: Unique sequential numbering under concurrency: (1) DB sequence (Postgres SERIAL/sequence) gives uniqueness but allows gaps — fine when no legal gapless requirement; (2) counter row + SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in a transaction gives gapless per-scope numbering, single hot-spot writer cost; (3) max()+1 outside transaction is racy (current EAMS bug — count()+1 and parse-based schemes collide under concurrency); (4) unique constraint/unique index on bastNumber is the last line of defense; assign number in same transaction as record insert; retry strategy for rare serialization errors (Prisma P2034).
